questions.prompt: The excellent poet obtained lasting glory through his own labor.
questions.answer: Poēta excellēns per labōrem suum glōriam perpetuam nactus est.

questions.prompt: The apple fell from the highest branch into the grass.
questions.answer: Pōmum ā rāmō altissimō in grāmen cecidit.

questions.prompt: The soldiers, wearied by the long march, sought rest.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs longō itinere fessī quiētem petēbant.

questions.prompt: War impoverished the once wealthy citizens.
questions.answer: Bellum cīvēs ōlim dīvitēs pauperāvit.

questions.prompt: The girl's gaze, fixed upon the stars, gleamed with joy.
questions.answer: Vīsus puellae in astra dēfīxus gaudiō splendēbat.

questions.prompt: The general's anger blazed up when the news had been heard.
questions.answer: Īra ducis, nūntiō audītō, exārsit.

questions.prompt: A gentle temperament makes a good king.
questions.answer: Temperāmentum mīte bonum rēgem facit.

questions.prompt: The guardian protected the orphan with great care.
questions.answer: Tūtor pupillum magnā cūrā tūtābātur.

questions.prompt: The rising of the sun delighted the weary sailors.
questions.answer: Ortus sōlis nautās fessōs dēlectāvit.

questions.prompt: The brave queen ruled the vast kingdom wisely.
questions.answer: Rēgīna fortis rēgnum ingēns sapienter rēxit.

questions.prompt: The children were playing on the green grass.
questions.answer: Līberī in grāmine viridī lūdēbant.

questions.prompt: The wise judge condemned the guilty man.
questions.answer: Iūdex sapiēns hominem nocentem damnāvit.

questions.prompt: A small addition increased the farmer's wealth.
questions.answer: Parva accessiō dīvitiās agricolae auxit.

questions.prompt: The stars shine brightly in the silent night.
questions.answer: Stēllae in nocte silentī clārē splendent.

questions.prompt: The messenger, sent by the king, announced the victory.
questions.answer: Nūntius ā rēge missus victōriam nūntiāvit.

questions.prompt: The old man began to weep in his daughter's embrace.
questions.answer: Senex in fīliae gremiō flēre incēpit.

questions.prompt: The waves, driven by the wind, struck the high cliffs.
questions.answer: Flūctūs ventō āctī altās rūpēs percussērunt.

questions.prompt: The physician healed the sick woman with new herbs.
questions.answer: Medicus fēminam aegram novīs herbīs sānāvit.

questions.prompt: The excellent orator won the applause of the whole crowd.
questions.answer: Ōrātor excellēns tōtīus turbae plausum nactus est.

questions.prompt: Because the tribune had spoken boldly, the frightened citizens fell silent.
questions.answer: Quia tribūnus audācter locūtus erat, cīvēs territī tacuērunt.

questions.prompt: The woman, eager for glory, endured the long war with a steadfast mind.
questions.answer: Mulier, glōriae cupida, longum bellum animō cōnstantī tolerāvit.

questions.prompt: A huge elephant, driven through the streets, terrified the shouting crowd.
questions.answer: Ingēns elephantus, per viās āctus, clāmantem turbam terruit.

questions.prompt: The nurse nourished the sick child with warm and gentle care.
questions.answer: Nūtrīx aegrum īnfantem cūrā tepidā ac lēnī nūtrīvit.
